form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital fillable form, typed. Every summary box carries a typed '0' (an actual written zero, not a blank cell) - a withdrawal report with no activity. The form prints no political-party field. Street address and signature are redacted upstream by the county (black bars) - the whole address line including city is blacked out, so residence_city is unrecoverable. Cover page header names Clerk/Auditor 'Josh Daniels'; the summary page (p4) header names 'Amelia Powers Gardner' - two form vintages bound into one PDF, noted but not adjudicated.

notes: Page 5 is not a report page: it is the county's internal 'Campaign Financial Disclosure Checklist' (two staff review blocks, reviewed 5/18/2022 and 5/13/22). Read but carries no filer-stated totals. The OCR locator flagged p5 as a summary page; it is not.
